warnings.message: Same full target sentence is reused across multiple scored activities.

data.normalizedTarget: yes i live near the school

manualReview.scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0106; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: I live near here and I live near the school are natural A1 residence statements.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy preserves live as «زندگی کردن/ساکن بودن».

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The learner answers the same location question with two controlled landmarks.

distractorQuality.evidence: I work near here is a plausible same-frame semantic contrast.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Talking about the route home naturally motivates asking where someone lives.

difficultyFit.evidence: Both learner responses use a familiar I + verb + location frame.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: live recurs through meaning recognition, dialogue, transfer and hidden retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: The second response replaces a general nearby location with a specific landmark.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, target sense, translations and retrieval align.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; subjective learner experience remains unverified.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The review covers only the bounded A1 residence sense of live.
Generated audio prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
resolvedFindings: English turns were checked for contextual plausibility.
Persian wording and orthography were checked.
The final activity requires hidden retrieval.
The walking-group arc returns after 5 Lessons and learner role rotates from Sara to Ruby.
